name: portfolio_three_sleeve
source: combination primitive from Lillo, Mazzarisi & Tsaknaki, Tackling estimation risk in Kelly investing using options
note: equal weight deliberately: optimised weights beat naive equal weight by less than the estimation error. A widened 3-name sleeve using velocity-trough strikes (arXiv:2608.12493) raises Sharpe to 1.63 on the window where all sleeves are live, but nearly triples full-period drawdown, so it is kept as strategies/put_vertical_singlename_wide.json rather than deployed.
